title: Lambdas, Higher-Order Functions, and Extensions Quick Check

questions.prompt: Which type represents a rule that accepts an Expense and returns true or false?
questions.explanation: Kotlin function types put parameter types before the arrow and the result type after it.

questions.prompt: An extension function can override a class member polymorphically.
questions.explanation: Members take precedence and extensions use static resolution from the declared receiver type.

questions.prompt: Match the common scope function to its result.
questions.explanation: Receiver-returning and block-result functions serve different chaining intentions.
